cwe_name: CWE-611: Improper Restriction of XML External Entity Reference

verifier.detail: The patch adds a centralized XmlParserUtils.createSecureDocumentBuilder() helper that hardens DocumentBuilderFactory against XXE (disallow-doctype-decl, disabled external general/parameter entities, disabled external DTD/schema access, disabled XInclude) and swaps all three flagged plugins (JunitXmlPlugin, TrxPlugin, XunitXmlPlugin) to use it instead of a bare DocumentBuilderFactory.newInstance()/newDocumentBuilder(). This is a minimal, standard, appropriate fix for the reported CWE-611 XXE alert, applied exactly at the locations identified in the alert traces.

reason: Patcher produced a patch from the alert (baseline: no exploit evidence, POV, or verifier gate).
cwe_name: CWE-611: Improper Restriction of XML External Entity Reference

verifier.detail: The patch adds standard XXE-hardening features (disallow-doctype-decl, disable external general/parameter entities, disable external DTD loading, disable XInclude/entity-reference expansion) to the DocumentBuilderFactory inside WebDriverManager.loadXML(), which is the single sink referenced by every trace in the CWE-611 alert (HTTP-fetched EdgeDriverManager XML, VersionDetector XML, and env-configured URL flows all funnel through this one static method). It also adds two focused unit tests verifying valid XML still parses and DOCTYPE/XXE payloads are now rejected. The change is minimal, targeted at the exact reported sink, and does not alter any other behavior.

reason: Patcher produced a patch from the alert (baseline: no exploit evidence, POV, or verifier gate).
cwe_name: CWE-79: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting')

verifier.detail: The patch fixes the CWE-79 stored-XSS alert in RestFileDownloadController by (1) always returning a fixed safe Content-Type (application/octet-stream) instead of deriving MIME type from the user-controlled file extension, (2) always forcing Content-Disposition to 'attachment' (removing the user-controllable 'a' parameter that allowed 'inline' rendering) with a quoted filename, and (3) sanitizing the filename to strip CR/LF/quote/backslash and non-ASCII/control characters before placing it in the header, preventing header injection. This directly closes both alert traces (Content-Type from extension, Content-Disposition from filename) while preserving legitimate file-download functionality.

cwe_name: CWE-79: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting')

verifier.detail: The patch adds three missing escape cases (backtick → \x60, forward slash → \/, hyphen → \-) to Escape.javaScriptAttribute() in jte-runtime/src/main/java/gg/jte/html/escape/Escape.java, directly at the location flagged by the CWE-79 alert. This mirrors the escaping already used in the sibling javaScriptBlock() method and matches the known upstream CVE-2025-23026 fix, closing template-literal/regex/comment breakout vectors in JS-attribute contexts (e.g. onclick="...").

cwe_name: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an OS Command ('OS Command Injection')

verifier.detail: The patch adds proper quoting/escaping of all user-controlled values (apiKey, cloudName, pcParameters, perfectoConnectLocation, pcLocation) before they are concatenated into the cmd.exe/bash command strings in PerfectoBuildWrapper.getTunnelId, directly addressing the CWE-078 OS command injection alert at the flagged lines. Build and tests pass in the project container.

reason: Patcher produced a patch from the alert (baseline: no exploit evidence, POV, or verifier gate).
cwe_name: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an SQL Command ('SQL Injection')
